facts.fact: ACTPOL says the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 took effect on 12 June 2023.
ACTPOL says the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 created an independent Nigeria Data Protection Commission, which it describes as an active regulator running registration, audit and investigations.
ACTPOL reports the Nigeria Data Protection Commission was reported to have fined MultiChoice Nigeria N766,242,500 in July 2025, in part for unlawful cross-border transfers.
